answer: Before the stamp comes 210 stamped dockets, each costing £61 to have checked, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. Every entry must show Meadowbound hedge cutter warren writ before the ledger opens, because a writ cutters sign after field checks. A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. One terrace, one entry. The tally keeps thread. The voyage is on the docket.
